root_cause: Prompt used round/pea/glass-sphere language; Krea maps hanging object in metal frame to a lamp
fix: Use S11 dialect: hanging amber coffee drop; teardrop of liquid coffee hanging in open air. Do not write round, pea, bulb, or enclosed glass sphere.
prevention: Lock tower geometry sentence from ART_BIBLE / S11 still. Never add round/pea to the drop.
